title: 低解像度のダミーモデルでローカル生成した動画をプレビズとして作り、出来が良ければそのプレビズ動画をSeedance…
content: 低解像度のダミーモデルでローカル生成した動画をプレビズとして作り、出来が良ければそのプレビズ動画をSeedance 2.5に参照（読み込み）させて仕上げるワークフローを使う
tips: 低解像度のダミーモデルでローカル生成した動画をプレビズとして作り、出来が良ければそのプレビズ動画をSeedance 2.5に参照（読み込み）させて仕上げるワークフローを使う

en.content:
Use a workflow where you create a locally generated video with a low-resolution dummy model as a previs, and if it turns out well, feed that previs video into Seedance 2.5 for the final polish.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
I’ve successfully done local generation with H3...
I feel more at ease with this kind of UI than with ComfyUI,
so I even had the UI built for me.

I want to try making a low-resolution video locally with a dummy model like the one shown on the left, and if it comes out looking good, load it into Seedance 2.5 or something similar as a previs video... https://t.co/2UUOLvFhbm
---

Usar un flujo de trabajo en el que se crea un video generado localmente con un modelo dummy de baja resolución como previz, y si el resultado es bueno, se hace que ese video de previz sea referenciado (cargado) por Seedance 2.5 para terminarlo.

--- TWEET CITADO ---
He logrado la generación local con H3…

hasta me hicieron la UI

fr.content:

--- TWEET CITÉ ---
